subject: Confusion concerning inla.core.safe:  inla.program has crashed

messages.author: df6dbd997e889816
messages.subject: Confusion concerning inla.core.safe:  inla.program has crashed
parts:
Hello everyone,

I am using INLA on the HPC cluster of our school. But it seems that it cannot work normally on the cluster. 

I ran the most basic model, which is just inla(formula, family = "gaussian", data = df_res[[1]],verbose=TRUE), 

but it gives me an error like 

Error in if (...length() && any(...names() == "Dimnames")) .Object@Dimnames <- fixupDN(.Object@Dimnames) : 

  missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed


 *** inla.core.safe:  inla.program has crashed: rerun to get better initial values. try=1/2 

Error in if (...length() && any(...names() == "Dimnames")) .Object@Dimnames <- fixupDN(.Object@Dimnames) : 

  missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed


 *** inla.core.safe:  inla.program has crashed: rerun to get better initial values. try=2/2 

Error in if (...length() && any(...names() == "Dimnames")) .Object@Dimnames <- fixupDN(.Object@Dimnames) : 

  missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed

Error in inla.core.safe(formula = formula, family = family, contrasts = contrasts,  : 

  *** Fail to get good enough initial values. Maybe it is due to something else.


I have tried this code on my local PC which gives the exact right results. I have tried using comments like inla.binary.install() but it still doesnot work on the cluster. 

Does anyone encounter the same problem on HPC cluster? If there is, please let me know.


Appreciate it so much.

Best,

Xicheng
